_comment: Checked by `npm run perf`. 'always' limits hold on any hardware (incl. software GL); 'gpu' limits are only enforced with --gpu on real hardware (software GL renders count as long tasks).

always._ww2TransferKB: WWII view measured 36.1 MB on 2026-11-18 (18.8 MB historical geometry, 6.9 MB topology, 5.7 MB territories). It was 70.8 MB when the geometry was 54 MB and nobody noticed; keep this check in CI.
